description:
A security audit has revealed that sensitive files on the 'acmecorp.test' website are publicly accessible. 

Your task is to configure the Apache web server directives for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server to DENY access to:
1. Any file named '.env'
2. The '.git' directory and its contents

The main website (e.g., index.html) MUST remain accessible. You must implement this configuration using Virtualmin's 'Edit Directives' feature (found under Services > Configure Website) or by editing the Apache configuration file directly via the UI. Do NOT delete the files; they must remain on the server for the developers, just not accessible via the web.
